notes.title: 1.0.0 Released
notes.content:
[b]Overview of Changes...[/b]
[list]
[*] Added 3 new abilities with a new delivery system (they appear at a random location and have a short delay before activating)
[olist]
[*] Green Target (reduces a ships HP temporarily if hit)
[*] Purple Target (deals massive damage to your ships if hit)
[*] Blue Target (EMPs your ships if hit)
[/olist]
[*] Changed the art for the EMP Front and EMP Mine ability (they were very similar to the EMP Random Direction ability before but now look unique)

[*] The background now...
[olist]
[*] Spins during combat
[*] Translates in every other situation when the mouse moves
[/olist]
[/list]
[b]Screenshots...[/b]

notes.title: 0.12.0 (Getting Closer) Released
notes.content:
[b]Overview of Changes...[/b]
[list]
[*] added 1 new ability called EMP bolt (2 variations, one activated by damage and one by a timer)
[*] added 1 new star map called "Variance" (2 variations, one short and one normal length)
[*] the way turret ability variations are selected has been improved...
[olist]
[*] the beginner star maps have more variations (this should be more exciting for new players to get into the game)
[*] selection is now entirely automatic (non-beginner star maps pick a few random variations for each playthrough rather than cycle through every unit in the game)
[/olist]
[*] added 5 new background colors (dark blue, dark red, dark purple, yellow and white)
[/list]

notes.title: 0.10.0 (More Beginner Friendly) Released
notes.content:
[b]Overview of Changes...[/b]

[u]Tutorial[/u][list][*]simplified and incorporated into gameplay over many rounds[/list]

[u]Difficulty Levels[/u]
[list][*]first few are much easier
[*]added 5 new ones staggered between the old ones so that there is less of a jump between them[/list]

[u]Maps[/u]
[list][*]added 4 new beginner maps so that it's easier to learn how to navigate them[/list]

[u]Turret Abilities[/u]
[list][*]added an option to select the quantity you will fight from a few presets ranging from very few to all[/list]
